svg.title: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 📉 One fewer decision to explain / 🧰 Conventions I would write again / 🚀 Rolling out a version on a green build / 🗺️ Reproduced with one clone / 🗝️ Keys that never live in a repo / 🎲 Generated nightly, nobody chose when / 🧪 Checks that run on every change / 🧹 Simplifying the boring parts / 🛟 A way back when it matters / 🤖 Nobody typed what you are reading / 🧭 Dull tooling over surprise / 🔍 Traces you can actually read
